[[File:Nightsister_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Nightsister wearing a carnage beret]]
A '''carnage beret''' was a ceremonial head covering worn by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> Various [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]] were known to have worn this, including [[Baritha]], [[Kimaru]]<ref name="SWG" /> and [[Morathax]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Morathax}}</ref>

The beret was made of Dathomirian [[Wood/Legends|wood]], crystalline gemstones, synthetic cloth and [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Bone/Legends|bones]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The carnage beret was a headgear item in [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. It was made from a schematic which could be looted from [[Axkva Min]] in the [[Chamber of Banishment]]. The schematic could be learned and made by a Domestic Goods Trader.
